collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-29  -  THE DIFFERENT PRAYER SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Two friends prepare for a remembrance gathering but discover that their families observe the occasion in different ways.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two friends prepare for a remembrance gathering but discover that their families observe the occasion in different ways.

choices.label: Ask What Each Custom Means to the Person Observing It.
Hold a Shared Period of Quiet Reflection.
Let Each Family Observe the Occasion Independently.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Each friend participates according to personal belief without disrupting the other.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The arrangements require compromise, but both families feel respected.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The friends understand one another better without needing to share the same beliefs.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: One friend prefers not to explain, and the other accepts the boundary.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers with different beliefs find their own meaning in the silence.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some prefer separate observances, and the organizers accommodate them.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friends spend less time together that evening but remain comfortable with their differences.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
d1__fx.text: The families gather afterward for a peaceful meal.
